title: GitHub Actions Workflow Plan
description: A structured plan of a GitHub Actions workflow's matrix shape, pinning policy, permissions, cloud auth, and cache/concurrency settings, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/github_actions_matrix_patterns_audit.mjs.

workflowKind.description: What this workflow is for: PR checks, release-branch CI, or a deployment.

thirdPartyActionPinning.description: How third-party actions are pinned: full commit SHA, an audited major tag (@v4), or a floating ref (@main/@latest).

topLevelPermissions.description: The workflow's top-level permissions block: explicit read-all, explicit write-all, or absent (inheriting the repo default).

cloudAuth.description: How the workflow authenticates to a cloud provider, if at all.

oidcSubClaimScope.description: How tight the OIDC trust policy's sub condition is: an environment claim, a specific branch ref, or a repo-wide wildcard.

matrixCellCount.description: Total number of cells the matrix expands to before exclusions.

excludeCount.description: Number of cells removed via exclude.

cacheKeyIncludesLockfileHash.description: True if every actions/cache primary key includes hashFiles() of the lockfile it covers.

concurrencyCancelInProgress.description: True if a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress is set for PR-triggered runs.

deployBehindEnvironment.description: True if the production deploy job declares environment: so GitHub protection rules (required reviewers, branch policy, wait timer) apply.

secretsInheritToForkPRs.description: True if secrets: inherit (or equivalent) is reachable from workflows triggered by fork PRs.
